name: CrossLink
summary: E-reader firmware for reTerminal Sticky, with CrossLink Pixel and CrossLink 2.0 variants.
description: CrossLink offers two e-reader firmware variants for reTerminal Sticky: CrossLink Pixel with a pixel-style reading interface and Chinese text layout, and CrossLink 2.0. Choose a variant and its version on the flashing page.

compatibility.notes: Requires 32 MB flash. Both variants use complete images written at 0x0. The contributor flashed CrossLink Pixel 4.3.0 and CrossLink 2.0 version 1.3.0 to a physical reTerminal Sticky and confirmed normal operation.

notes.title: Before installation
notes.description: Requires a reTerminal Sticky with 32 MB flash. Back up device data before installing either variant.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: Connect the device with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge. Select a variant and version, then write its complete image at offset 0x0.
